# JachaiX Project Context

## Project Overview
Bangla-first multimodal trust and fact-checking platform for Bangladesh.

## Tech Stack
- Python (78.1%): ML models, APIs, data processing
- PHP (8.1%): Backend services
- TypeScript (6.8%): Frontend
- Jupyter Notebooks (2.9%): Research & analysis

## Key Considerations
- Bangla language support is critical
- Multimodal content (text, images, videos)
- Trust scores and fact-checking algorithms
- Cultural context for Bangladesh
- Privacy and data protection

## Coding Standards
- Python: Follow PEP 8, use type hints
- PHP: Follow PSR-12
- TypeScript: Use strict mode
- Write tests for critical fact-checking logic
- Document Bangla-specific handling
